The answer key · every base case of the campaign

Answer Sheet

For each of the 85 cases: what the customer says, the meaning it carries, the dialog state it answers and what that state allows, the tool calls a correct bot must make with the results the mock bank returns, and the response it must give — followed by the expected outcome.

How to read a case. Customer is the exact line the bot under test receives at the base levels. means is the canonical meaning card the reader must recover — the ground truth, independent of wording. Correct bot behaviour lists the acts the bot must perform and the tool calls in order, with the status the mock bank returns. The collapsed line in a turn shows the same turn in an enriched variant’s messy wording: by the invariance proof (gmsjourney/enrich/invariance.py) it carries the identical meaning card and therefore the identical answer key.
